country.evidence_quote: For Nations, Métis Settlements, and band administrators: we deliver training in your community, work alongside your employment and training staff, and leave the curriculum with you so the capacity stays local. First Nations and Métis Settlements are eligible employers under the Canada-Alberta Productivity Grant, which reimburses 50 to 75% of eligible training costs.

external_collaboration.evidence_quote: We have built curriculum for Win Together Canada Foundation, delivered team dynamics training for the YMCA, supported funded programs with Employabilities, and led grant-writing and board strategic planning workshops for grassroots organizations. Where a community prefers on-territory delivery, we travel and train locally so the capacity stays in the community.
